summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco Large Cap Growth ETF (PWB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index that uses a multifactor selection methodology to select large-cap stocks with growth characteristics. PWB was launched on Mar 3, 2005 and is issued by Invesco.
infoTable: Dynamic Large Cap Growth Intellidex Index (AMEX)

holdings.infoBox: PWB is an equity ETF with a total of 53 individual holdings. The top holdings are Advanced Micro Devices stock at 4.01%, Meta Platforms at 3.98%, Intel at 3.78%, Micron Technology at 3.48%, and Apple at 3.43%.
